samples.user_input: What punishment is provided for qatl-i-amd under section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code?
samples.response: Section 302 of the Pakistan Penal Code provides that the punishment for qatl-i-amd is death or imprisonment for life, and in cases where the principle of *fasadfilarz* is not attracted, imprisonment for a term which may extend to twenty-five years. [pakistan_law.md#174]

samples.reference: Section 302 provides death as qisas; death or imprisonment for life as ta'zir when the required proof under Section 304 is unavailable; or imprisonment up to twenty-five years where qisas is not applicable under the Injunctions of Islam.

samples.user_input: According to Section 302, when can qatl-i-amd be punished with tazir instead of qisas, and what forms of proof are mentioned in the referenced Section 304?
samples.response: According to Section 302, qatl-i-amd can be punished with tazir instead of qisas if the proof in either of the forms specified in Section 304 is not available. The forms of proof mentioned in Section 304 are: (a) a voluntary and true confession by the accused before a competent court, or (b) evidence as provided in Article 17 of the QanuneShahadat, 1984. [pakistan_law\pakistan_law.md#173]
